narrative.executive_summary: Our real-time threat detection system has identified no critical threats, but several low-severity anomalies across various domains. The retail_clothing domain shows the highest number of low-severity anomalies, with 4 out of 10 total missions executed detecting potential issues. Immediate action is required to address these low-severity threats before they escalate.

threat_vectors.name: Inventory Imbalances
threat_vectors.description: Potential inventory imbalances detected across various locations, indicating a risk of stockouts or overstocking.

threat_vectors.name: Supplier On-Time Rate Variability
threat_vectors.description: Variability in supplier on-time delivery rates, which may impact overall supply chain efficiency.

threat_vectors.name: Product Stock-out Risk
threat_vectors.description: Potential stock-out risk detected for certain products, which may impact sales performance.

immediate_actions: Review and adjust inventory management processes to prevent imbalances and ensure optimal stock levels.
Engage with suppliers to address on-time delivery variability and negotiate more favorable terms.
Analyze sales data to identify products at risk of stock-out and adjust inventory levels accordingly.
monitoring_recommendations: Continuously monitor inventory levels and supplier performance to detect potential issues early.
Regularly review sales data to identify trends and adjust inventory levels accordingly.
